reviews.title: Never buy returned items just cause its cheaper!!!
reviews.comment: Bought this item as excelllent condition ,returned item .   Dumbest  thing ive ever done.   Built my whole pc   turned it on and what do you know,a black screen .     With error codes popping off on the board. I did everything i could to trouble shoot . Came to the conclusion   something is faulty on board .   Best buy really needs to stop selling returned items  ,or start thoroughly  checking items out .  Its been over 15 days so i cant even return this junk for a refund. It was a gamble i took and  i sure did lose...
